entry.command: python3 -B -c 'import sys,json,subprocess,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,"/home/root/kv260-dfx-state-boardtest-20261004/board"); import validate_v5 as v; p=subprocess.run(["systemctl","show","dfx-mgr.service","-p","MainPID","-p","ActiveState","-p","SubState","-p","Result","-p","ExecStart","-p","DropInPaths","-p","Requires","-p","After"],check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True); props=dict(line.split("=",1) for line in p.stdout.splitlines()); pid=int(props["MainPID"]); state=v.watch_state(pid); boot=v.read("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id"); assert boot=="01ca88c1-93b6-414f-9646-774482d4b2f0"; assert props["ActiveState"]=="active" and props["SubState"]=="running" and props["Result"]=="success"; assert str(pathlib.Path("/proc/%d/exe"%pid).resolve())==str(v.NEW); assert v.sha(v.NEW)==v.NEW_SHA; assert v.read("/sys/block/mmcblk1/device/cid")==v.CID; assert v.read("/sys/module/zocl/srcversion")==v.ZOCL; assert v.read("/sys/module/zocl/parameters/enable_xgq_ert")=="1"; assert v.PERSIST.read_text()==v.PERSIST_CONTENT and not v.TEMP.exists(); assert state["watch_count"]==5 and state["inotify_fd_count"]==1 and state["overlays"]==["kv260-benchmark-b4096_image_1"] and state["render_nodes"]==["renderD128"]; subprocess.run(["sha256sum","-c",str(v.STOCK)],check=True); print("LIVE "+json.dumps({"boot_id":boot,"cid":v.CID,"manager_sha256":v.sha(v.NEW),"manager_bytes":v.NEW.stat().st_size,"persistent_dropin_sha256":v.sha(v.PERSIST),"zocl_srcversion":v.ZOCL,"properties":props,"state":state}))'
